title: AERC Collaborative Masters Programme (CMAP) Scholarship in Economics
description:
AERC master’s scholarships for students from Anglophone sub-Saharan Africa admitted to an economics master’s at a CMAP partner university.

  • Scholarship for master’s study in economics at an African partner university
  • Joint Facility for Electives in Nairobi

Eligibility: Citizens of Anglophone sub-Saharan African countries with an upper second-class degree in economics or a related field, admitted to a CMAP university; women and applicants from fragile states are encouraged.

How to apply: Apply for admission to a CMAP university first, then upload your admission letter to the AERC scholarship portal. The last call closed on 15 May; the 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: L’Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Young Talents Sub-Saharan Africa
description:
Thirty research fellowships a year for young African women scientists, plus leadership training.

  • EUR 10,000 for doctoral candidates
  • EUR 15,000 for post-doctoral researchers
  • Scientific leadership training

Eligibility: Women with the nationality of a sub-Saharan African country, working or enrolled in a doctoral programme in the region, in life, physical, mathematical, computer or engineering sciences.

How to apply: The 2025 call ran 24 February - 7 April; the 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: Allan Gray Orbis Foundation Fellowship
description:
A fully funded undergraduate fellowship for future high-impact entrepreneurs from South Africa, Eswatini, Botswana and Namibia.

  • Tuition, accommodation and living costs at a partner university
  • Entrepreneurship development programme

Eligibility: Citizens of South Africa (or Eswatini, Botswana and Namibia through a separate stream) aged 21 or under, with at least 70% in Grade 11, planning to start an undergraduate degree.

How to apply: The last deadline was 30 April 2026; the 2027 window is expected to open in early 2027.

title: RUFORUM TAGDev 2.0 Scholarships
description:
Mastercard Foundation-backed scholarships for young Africans in agriculture and related fields at RUFORUM member universities (2023-2033 programme).

  • Tuition and fees
  • Accommodation and living stipend
  • Entrepreneurship and community engagement

Eligibility: Academically talented but disadvantaged young Africans admitted to TAGDev partner universities such as Gulu, Egerton, Cape Coast and Port Harcourt.

How to apply: Calls are published by each partner university; the 2026 calls appeared in March 2026, so the 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: Wells Mountain Initiative Scholars Program
description:
Partial scholarships for students in developing countries studying in their own country or region, with a community-service commitment.

  • USD 300 - 3,000 a year toward tuition and costs
  • Membership of the WMI scholar community

Eligibility: Students from developing countries pursuing a first certificate, diploma or bachelor’s degree in their home country or region who show financial need and community service.

How to apply: Applications are expected to run from 1 December 2026 to 1 March 2027 (11:59 pm EST); results by 1 August 2027.

title: South Asian University President’s Scholarship
description:
Merit scholarships at the university founded by the eight SAARC countries, for master’s and PhD students from South Asia.

  • Master’s: two President’s Scholarships per programme each year (one for a non-Indian student)
  • PhD: scholarship for up to five years

Eligibility: Students from the SAARC countries admitted to South Asian University master’s or PhD programmes.

How to apply: Admission deadlines were in April - May 2026; the 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: SFU International Excellence Entrance Scholarship
description:
An automatic CAD 10,000 award for excellent international high-school applicants from target regions.

  • CAD 10,000 one-off award for Fall entry

Eligibility: Incoming international high-school applicants from specified regions with excellent grades; no application needed.

How to apply: Considered automatically when you apply for admission for Fall 2027.

title: University of Wollongong University Excellence Scholarship
description:
A 30% tuition reduction for high-achieving international students starting at UOW in 2027 or later.

  • 30% tuition fee reduction for the minimum course duration

Eligibility: International students meeting the academic threshold for an eligible UOW course.

How to apply: No application needed; assessed with your admission application.

title: University of Wollongong Postgraduate Academic Excellence Scholarship
description:
A 30% tuition reduction for international coursework master’s students with an outstanding prior degree.

  • 30% tuition fee reduction

Eligibility: International applicants to a UOW coursework master’s with a comparable bachelor’s or master’s at 85% or above.

How to apply: Assessed with your admission application.

title: Korea University Global Leader Scholarship (Graduate)
description:
Admission scholarships for international graduate students at Korea University, up to full tuition plus living support in some schools.

  • Type A/B/C tuition scholarships for the first semester
  • Business School Global Leader: 100% tuition plus KRW 2,000,000 living support

Eligibility: International graduate applicants meeting language and GPA thresholds (Type A needs a department recommendation); renew by applying each semester.

How to apply: Apply with your graduate admission application.

title: NUS Science & Technology Undergraduate Scholarship
description:
A scholarship for outstanding Asian students (outside Singapore) studying science and technology at NUS.

  • Subsidised tuition after the Tuition Grant
  • Living, accommodation and computer allowances

Eligibility: Citizens of Asian countries other than Singapore admitted to eligible science and technology courses; a work obligation in Singapore applies.

How to apply: Apply through the regular undergraduate admission application (no separate scholarship form for most awards); the 2027 deadline is an estimate.

title: NUS Goh Keng Swee Scholarship
description:
A prestigious NUS undergraduate scholarship for citizens of selected ASEAN and Asian countries.

  • Tuition support and living allowances

Eligibility: Citizens of the listed ASEAN and Asian countries admitted to NUS.

How to apply: Apply through the regular undergraduate admission application (no separate scholarship form for most awards); the 2027 deadline is an estimate.

title: NTU Nanyang Global Scholarship
description:
NTU’s undergraduate scholarship open to outstanding students of all nationalities.

  • Tuition support and living allowances

Eligibility: International undergraduate applicants of any nationality with outstanding records.

How to apply: Apply through the regular undergraduate admission application (no separate scholarship form for most awards); the 2027 deadline is an estimate.

title: NTU Science and Technology Undergraduate Scholarship
description:
A scholarship for Asian students (outside Singapore) in science and technology at NTU.

  • Subsidised tuition after the Tuition Grant
  • Living allowances

Eligibility: Citizens of Asian countries other than Singapore; the Tuition Grant carries a three-year Singapore work obligation.

How to apply: Apply through the regular undergraduate admission application (no separate scholarship form for most awards); the 2027 deadline is an estimate.

title: UTM ASCEND Bright Talent Scholarship
description:
A postgraduate scholarship for high-achieving local and international students at UTM.

  • RM 3,000 monthly allowance

Eligibility: High-achieving local and international postgraduate candidates.

How to apply: Check UTM’s School of Graduate Studies for the current call.

title: UTM International Doctoral Fellowship
description:
Partial tuition waivers for international doctoral students at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.

  • RM 2,000 tuition waiver

Eligibility: International students enrolled in a UTM doctoral programme.

How to apply: The last window was 22 September - 10 October 2026; the next is expected at the same time in 2027.

title: Xiamen University New International Students Scholarship
description:
Xiamen University’s own first-, second- and third-class scholarships for new international degree students in 2027.

  • First class: full tuition plus RMB 2,500 a month living allowance (bachelor’s)
  • Second and third class: partial tuition waivers

Eligibility: New international students admitted to a Xiamen University degree programme; five first-class awards per programme level.

How to apply: Apply through the university’s online system between 1 December 2026 and 30 April 2027 after being admitted.

title: Shanghai Jiao Tong University SJTU Scholarship for International Students
description:
SJTU’s own merit scholarship for international students, in three tiers from a quarter of tuition to full tuition plus living allowance.

  • Tier 1: full tuition and a living allowance
  • Tier 2: half tuition
  • Tier 3: a quarter of tuition

Eligibility: International applicants admitted to SJTU degree programmes; graduate applicants apply through SJTU or a Chinese embassy, not both.

How to apply: Apply with your SJTU admission application for 2027; check the 2027 scholarships section for dates.

title: Fudan University Scholarship for International Students
description:
A university-funded award for excellent international applicants to Fudan, alongside the Chinese and Shanghai government scholarships.

  • Tuition support based on academic performance and admission results

Eligibility: Excellent international applicants admitted to Fudan degree programmes.

How to apply: The 2027 notice had not been published at the time of writing; the dates are an estimate based on the 2026 cycle.

title: DGIST International Graduate Scholarship
provider: Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology (DGIST)
description:
Automatic scholarships for every admitted international graduate student at DGIST, a leading Korean science and technology institute.

  • Master’s: at least KRW 15 million a year (DGIST-funded)
  • PhD: at least KRW 22 million a year (DGIST-funded)
  • Performance-based incentives

Eligibility: International students admitted to a DGIST master’s or PhD programme; amounts depend on the funding type.

How to apply: Admitted students are registered for scholarships automatically; check DGIST’s admissions calendar for the next round.

title: Sungkyunkwan University STEM Scholarship for International Graduate Students
description:
A first-semester scholarship for new international graduate students in SKKU’s STEM programmes.

  • Conditional award: up to 100% of tuition and admission fees
  • Unconditional award: 50% of tuition and the full admission fee

Eligibility: Newly admitted international graduate students in STEM departments.

How to apply: Considered at admission; continuing support depends on GPA.

title: University of Tsukuba Scholarship for English-Program Undergraduates
description:
A monthly living allowance for international students on the University of Tsukuba’s English-taught bachelor’s programmes.

  • Living allowance of JPY 60,000 a month (2024 cycle)

Eligibility: International applicants to Tsukuba’s English-taught undergraduate programmes.

How to apply: Apply with your English-programme admission application.

title: Hiroshima University Prior to Admission Scholarship Program (HU-PASP)
description:
A pre-arrival scholarship for about 11 new international graduate students at Hiroshima University.

  • One year of tuition
  • JPY 50,000 a month

Eligibility: Privately financed international applicants to Hiroshima University graduate programmes, before enrolment.

How to apply: Apply through Hiroshima University before admission; check the page for the current schedule.

title: Nazarbayev University Abay Kunanbayev Scholarship
description:
A full scholarship for international students recommended for admission to Nazarbayev University’s English-taught programmes.

  • Full tuition
  • Basic medical insurance
  • Monthly stipend

Eligibility: International candidates who pass the merit-based selection and are recommended by the programme’s admissions committee.

How to apply: Apply through admissions.nu.edu.kz; international deadlines differ from those for Kazakhstani candidates, so the dates are an estimate.

title: Thailand International Postgraduate Programme (TIPP)
description:
Fully funded master’s scholarships from the Thai government at leading Thai universities for nominees from partner developing countries.

  • Tuition
  • Living, accommodation and settlement allowances
  • Book and thesis allowances

Eligibility: Nationals of eligible countries nominated by their national focal point, aged 45 or under, with good English; up to five nominees per country per programme.

How to apply: TICA has announced 23 programmes for 2027, with closing dates still to be confirmed; dates shown are estimates.

title: UNSW Canberra Postgraduate Research Scholarships
description:
Stipend scholarships for domestic and international research students at UNSW Canberra (at the Australian Defence Force Academy).

  • Stipend up to AUD 38,438 a year (flat rate)
  • Faculty scholarships and University Postgraduate Awards for international candidates

Eligibility: Domestic and international applicants admitted to a research degree at UNSW Canberra.

How to apply: Apply through UNSW research admissions; rounds run several times a year, so the date shown is an estimate.

title: Ryoichi Sasakawa Young Leaders Fellowship (Sylff) at UNSW Business School
description:
Sylff fellowships for PhD students with leadership potential at UNSW Business School, part of a global network of Sylff institutions.

  • Fellowship for PhD study
  • Sylff Research Abroad grant of up to USD 5,000

Eligibility: PhD students at UNSW Business School; eligible candidates receive an application form from the Research Office.

How to apply: The Business School Research Office contacts eligible students; the date shown is an estimate.

title: Adelaide University Research Scholarships (AURS)
description:
Research scholarships with a stipend and full tuition waiver for graduate researchers at Adelaide University.

  • Living stipend for the scholarship duration
  • 100% tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Domestic applicants, or international applicants who completed a relevant Australian or New Zealand qualification (Graduate Research Talent Scheme round).

How to apply: Apply in the published scholarship rounds; the date shown is an estimate.

title: UBC Four Year Doctoral Fellowship (4YF)
description:
About 215 new four-year doctoral fellowships a year at UBC, awarded on merit regardless of citizenship.

  • CAD 24,000 a year stipend plus tuition, for up to four years (from September 2026)

Eligibility: Doctoral students of any citizenship nominated by their UBC graduate programme.

How to apply: No separate application: graduate programmes select recipients from their applicants.

title: UBC International Tuition Award (Graduate)
description:
An automatic tuition award for international graduate students in research master’s and doctoral programmes at UBC Vancouver.

  • Up to CAD 3,200 a year

Eligibility: Full-time international students in research-oriented master’s and doctoral programmes whose tuition is not paid by external funding.

How to apply: No application; all eligible international graduate students are considered automatically.

title: McGill Differential Fee Waiver for International Graduate Students
description:
Waivers of the international tuition supplement for selected international doctoral (and some thesis master’s) students at McGill.

  • CAD 16,045 (PhD) or CAD 18,231 (master’s) a year in 2026/27
  • First three years of a PhD or first year of a master’s

Eligibility: Full-time international graduate students paying international fees, nominated by their faculty.

How to apply: No application form; units nominate students.

title: Concordia International Doctoral Tuition Award of Excellence
description:
Every incoming international doctoral student at Concordia pays Québec-resident tuition rates through this award.

  • Tuition reduced to the Québec rate (about CAD 47,463 in value)

Eligibility: Incoming international and US doctoral students admitted to Concordia, unless sponsored by an external agency.

How to apply: Awarded automatically on admission.

title: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship
description:
A fully funded 12-week summer research internship at Canadian universities for top undergraduates from partner countries such as India, Brazil, China and Mexico.

  • Round-trip airfare to Canada
  • Housing and food stipends
  • Health insurance
  • Up to CAD 300 for enrolment fees

Eligibility: Senior undergraduates from eligible partner countries (country-specific GPA minimums); India alone sends 300 students a year from 2027 under an AICTE agreement.

How to apply: The summer 2027 call is closed; the call for 2028 is expected around the second half of 2027.

title: DAAD In-Country/In-Region Scholarship: Master of Water and Environmental Science Engineering at 2iE
description:
DAAD scholarships for Sub-Saharan African students on the Master of Water and Environmental Science Engineering master’s programme at 2iE, Burkina Faso (study starts in September).

  • Tuition fees
  • Monthly scholarship rate
  • Study and research allowance
  • Thesis printing allowance
  • Travel allowance and usually health insurance for in-region scholars

Eligibility: Sub-Saharan African citizens with a relevant bachelor’s degree, usually planning to teach or do research at an African university or institution; in-country (home country) or in-region (another Sub-Saharan country).

How to apply: Apply to the host institution following its DAAD call; the deadline shown is an estimate, so check the institution’s call document.

title: RAMDDA Intra-Africa Academic Mobility Scholarship: Drug Discovery
provider: RAMDDA consortium (EU Intra-Africa Academic Mobility Scheme)
description:
EU-funded master’s and PhD scholarships for African students to study drug discovery at partner universities in another African country; coordinated by the University of Botswana. Partners include BIUST, Addis Ababa University and the University of the Free State.

  • Tuition and participation costs
  • Monthly stipend (EUR 890 for master’s, EUR 1,230 for PhD)
  • Return travel, visa and insurance
  • Settling-in allowance and research costs

Eligibility: African nationals living in an African country. Target group 1: students of the partner universities; target group 2: students from other African universities. Some places are reserved for women, refugees and students with disabilities.

How to apply: Calls are published on the project website; the dates shown are an estimate based on the last call.

provider: MOTION consortium (EU Intra-Africa Academic Mobility Scheme)
